description: Iron Age multivallate hillfort re-occupied from the early 5th CE. During the final phase of the new settlement (late 5th - early 6th CE) eight timber framed structures were built, seemingly one was suggested to be a shrine.
bibliography: Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Cadbury Congresbury (Somerset).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
Rahtz. “Cadbury Congresbury 1968-73. A Late/Post-Roman Hilltop Settlement in Somerset.” British Archaeological Reports (British Series) 223 (1992).
